selected_evidence.requirement: Create a local certificate authority named OS Comparison Root CA
selected_evidence.summary: Proves local key generation, requested certificate identity, CA extensions, secure permissions, and matching key/certificate public keys.

selected_evidence.requirement: Install the CA certificate as a trusted system certificate authority
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu added the certificate, created trust links, and successfully validated newly signed leaf certificates through its system CA directory and aggregate bundle.
Captures the healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot identity, running post-restart system state, persisted CA files, and successful post-restart trust validation.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s ip=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME" "$NODE_IP"
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'sudo='; if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then echo noninteractive; else echo unavailable; fi
printf 'trust_dir='; if [ -d /usr/local/share/ca-certificates ]; then echo present; else echo missing; fi
printf 'update_ca='; command -v update-ca-certificates || true

set -eu
command -v openssl
for p in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt; do if sudo test -e "$p"; then printf 'exists %s\n' "$p"; else printf 'absent %s\n' "$p"; fi; done

set -eu
sudo openssl genrsa -out /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key 4096
sudo chown root:root /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo chmod 600 /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
sudo stat -c 'key=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a bytes=%s' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key

set -eu
sudo openssl req -x509 -new -sha256 -days 3650 -key /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -out /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -subj '/CN=OS Comparison Root CA' -addext 'basicConstraints=critical,CA:TRUE' -addext 'keyUsage=critical,keyCertSign,cRLSign' -addext 'subjectKeyIdentifier=hash'
sudo chown root:root /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo chmod 644 /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
sudo openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo update-ca-certificates
printf 'bundle_link='; readlink -f /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
printf 'hash_link='; openssl x509 -hash -noout -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt | xargs -I '{}' sh -c 'readlink -f /etc/ssl/certs/{}.0'
openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt

commands.command:
set -eu
work=/tmp/os-comparison-ca-proof
rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -m 700 "$work"
openssl genrsa -out "$work/leaf.key" 2048 >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl req -new -key "$work/leaf.key" -out "$work/leaf.csr" -subj '/CN=trust-proof.local'
sudo openssl x509 -req -in "$work/leaf.csr" -CA /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -CAcreateserial -out "$work/leaf.crt" -days 1 -sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running || true
sudo stat -c 'key_owner=%U:%G key_mode=%a' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
stat -c 'cert_owner=%U:%G cert_mode=%a' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -text | sed -n '/X509v3 Basic Constraints/,+5p'
printf 'key_pub_sha256='; sudo openssl pkey -in /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -pubout 2>/dev/null | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'cert_pub_sha256='; openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -pubkey -noout | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}'
printf 'system_bundle_leaf_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$work/leaf.crt"
rm -rf "$work"
sudo rm -f /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.srl

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'pre_reboot_boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
sudo sh -c 'nohup sh -c "sleep 2; /usr/sbin/reboot" >/dev/null 2>&1 &'
echo 'reboot_acknowledged=scheduled'

set -eu
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true); [ "$state" = running ] && break; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done
work=/tmp/os-comparison-ca-post-reboot
rm -rf "$work"
mkdir -m 700 "$work"
openssl genrsa -out "$work/leaf.key" 2048 >/dev/null 2>&1
openssl req -new -key "$work/leaf.key" -out "$work/leaf.csr" -subj '/CN=post-reboot-trust-proof.local'
sudo openssl x509 -req -in "$work/leaf.csr" -CA /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -CAkey /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key -CAserial "$work/ca.srl" -CAcreateserial -out "$work/leaf.crt" -days 1 -sha256 >/dev/null 2>&1
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state=%s\n' "$state"
sudo stat -c 'key=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a bytes=%s' /etc/ssl/private/os-comparison-root-ca.key
stat -c 'cert=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a bytes=%s' /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt
openssl x509 -in /usr/local/share/ca-certificates/os-comparison-root-ca.crt -noout -subject -issuer -serial -dates
printf 'named_trust_link='; readlink -f /etc/ssl/certs/os-comparison-root-ca.pem
printf 'ca_path_verify='; openssl verify -CApath /etc/ssl/certs "$work/leaf.crt"
printf 'system_bundle_verify='; openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt "$work/leaf.crt"
rm -rf "$work"
